daysBack.title: Days of new domains
daysBack.description: How many daily lists to scan, newest first (1 = domains registered yesterday). Each day adds roughly 1,500-2,000 new Shopify stores.

countries.title: Store countries (optional)
countries.description: Keep stores whose Shopify business address is in these countries. Two-letter codes, e.g. US, GB, CA, AU, DE.

keywords.title: Domain keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Keep only domains containing one of these words, e.g. pet, coffee, skin, fitness, jewelry.

tlds.title: TLDs (optional)
tlds.description: Keep only these domain endings, e.g. com, shop, store, co.uk.

currencies.title: Store currencies (optional)
currencies.description: Keep stores selling in these currencies, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

minProducts.title: Min published products
minProducts.description: Skip stores with fewer published products. 0 keeps empty new stores too.

onlyLaunched.title: Only launched stores
onlyLaunched.description: Skip stores still behind Shopify's password page (not open to shoppers yet). Leave off to reach owners while they are still building.

requireEmail.title: Only stores with an email
requireEmail.description: Skip stores where no email was found on the homepage, contact policy or contact page.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: shopify (found by DNS, covers every new store), woocommerce, bigcommerce (found by fingerprinting a capped number of other new sites, see below).

maxSitesToFingerprint.title: Max other sites to fingerprint
maxSitesToFingerprint.description: Only used for woocommerce or bigcommerce. How many non-Shopify live domains to open and check per run. Higher finds more stores but takes longer.

maxStores.title: Max stores per run
maxStores.description: Cap on store rows. Controls cost.

dedupe.title: Skip stores returned in earlier runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned stores across runs. Turn on for a daily scheduled lead feed.
